Southern Bbq Chicken
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 15, 2009 - 1:21pm

Ingredients




1 chicken, quartered or cut up
1/2 cup ketchup
2 tablespoons Heinz 57 sauce
1 teaspoon Texas Pete hot sauce
1 tablespoon vegetable oil
1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce
1/4 cup brown sugar
1/4 teaspoon pepper
6 tablespoons vinegar
1 sm. onion, cut up

Preparation

1 Clean chicken. Mix all other ingredients together well. Place chicken in rectangular baking dish in a single layer. Pour sauce over chicken, coating well. Cover with foil. Bake 2-3 hours in 325 degree oven, basting regularly.
